script: Ancient Babylon's prophecies might be unfolding right now with AI. For centuries, Babylon symbolized immense global power and influence, eventually collapsing. But ancient texts often spoke of a future 'new Babylon' – a system of vast control impacting the entire world. Fast forward to today: Artificial Intelligence is rapidly developing capabilities we once only dreamed of. AI can analyze unprecedented amounts of data, influence global markets, and even shape information flows across continents. Think about how a truly advanced AI could centralize power, knowledge, and even decision-making on a global scale. This digital age parallels ancient warnings about a singular, all-encompassing system. It makes you wonder if these ancient predictions about a powerful, global system are eerily close to the rise of AI right now.
comment: What's your take: is AI the 'new Babylon' of ancient prophecies?
